subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this narrow opt-in model-provider request limiter as the first slice of outbound API rate limiting?
rationale: The patch adds public config and provider-routing behavior while the linked canonical issue still spans budgets, status/CLI, backoff, tools/search, channels, persistence, and alerts, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
options.body: Approve the opt-in provider-dispatch slice after rebase, preserving default no-op behavior and current egress secret handling.

options.title: Hold For Broader Design
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers settle the full outbound governance shape for budgets, CLI/status, tools, channels, and persistence.

options.title: Route To Follow-Up API Design
options.body: Keep the broad tracker open and ask for a smaller design note or issue before landing any new config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in provider-dispatch slice after rebase, preserving default no-op behavior and current egress secret handling.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current product/API scoping signal and recently changed the adjacent egress boundary this PR must preserve.
